notes.title: Prepare for a romance after dark
notes.content:
[b]The game is almost complete and we plan to release it on STEAM this DECEMBER.[/b]

I’m amazed with it. It’s so different from the games we’ve developed so far. Much more mature. Not only in terms of visuals but also emotions and stories you’ll find there. Of course, I won’t say, that some of you gonna shed a tear during the gameplay, no. But I’m sure you’ll feel sorrow, compassion and respect. This emotional bond you’re having with a character you desire, when you know her troubling past, her dreams and weaknesses, finally makes the intimate situation much more personal and mature. Mixing that difficult emotions with erotic content isn’t easy but I believe we’ve been subtle enough to do it right, mainly thanks to just outstanding copywriting you gonna find in that game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39992657/a6d2b59d992868690d7a3ceb927ca21fa490397b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39992657/d945fcbe8d2eb8cdbd31945bc4f4ac3716bbd09b.jpg[/img]

Stylish renders and artistic music causes this noir atmosphere to feel authentic – you almost can smell the scent of cigarettes the characters are smoking on the screen. Different styling helps us in narration too, makes the whole experience much more unique and realistic. Sometimes bizarre, sometimes funny but always full of emotions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39992657/fd13b60d3f02eefbc05f2d7c8a7a19cd76ae11dd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39992657/c7eccc32da54f82c03d9007bc03177b8ec344cf7.jpg[/img]

Also the gameplay – so different from dating sims and visual novels. You can freely travel around Arkham, visit various places, push your case forward and interact with other girls. Game is far from being linear – your choices seriously influences the story which can be completed in 10 different ways. You can, of course, count on a sex scenes and endings gallery + bonus image gallery with some really twisted pictures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39992657/8d780fc7349fcb8b1e1f6d46fae446e8e4f31ad2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39992657/71b68900f275865bfd636c519931961be84310e1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39992657/34c83af25bfa246db44d8c6047f5fcb8debb7318.jpg[/img]

It’s not another dating sim full of cheating wives and naughty secretaries just waiting to jump on your cock. No.
[b]It’s the most artistic game we’ve developed so far and experience you’ll remember for a very long time.[/b]

notes.title: Work in progress
notes.content:
There are 3 main plots here – for a professional singer Miranda, Teresa the librarian and a young prostitute Sara. Those plots are crossing their paths in a very smart and natural way – in our previous games, if you wanted to invest your feelings into one girl, it was enough if you pursued only her path. Here you need to balance your attention between various characters in order to achieve your goals.

I especially love moral choices you are forced to make here – not always obvious, resulting bad or good outcome. In terms of the story it’s the darkest and the most ambitious game we’ve developed so far and I’m proud that we’re trying to experiment with the erotic genre and explore that noir themes.

Visuals – those girls are not typical LOP models. But this game isn’t typical as well. That ladies got their past, their flaws, their weaknesses and goals to achieve. Putting fashion models into their roles wouldn’t be authentic. We wanted girls shaped by their problems and sorrows but also arousing and full of passion. The aesthetics we’ve used here matches perfectly the game atmosphere and completes the whole game experience.

[b]When to expect the game? I would say around November 2021.[/b]
